datasets.nstdb: PhysioNet MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test Database 1.0.0 (ODC-By 1.0)

rule: Adopt a candidate over v0.1 only if, on VALIDATION data: (1) AF sensitivity drops by at most 2 points on AFDB-val and on MIT-BIH-val, and no AFDB-val AF patient's AF sensitivity drops by more than 10 points; (2) CinC val challenge F1 drops by at most 1 point; (3) false-AF windows on AFDB-val + MIT-BIH-val are fewer than v0.1's. Among passing candidates, fewest false-AF windows wins. Fixed before any AFDB result.
